name: Typeform
description: Convert a public Typeform into an editable Talkform draft, then review every field before launching a browser interview.
steps: Review extracted labels, options, and required flags
limitations: Complex logic jumps may not reproduce exactly
Payments, file uploads, hidden fields, and account-only forms require a manual workflow
The importer does not modify the source Typeform

name: Google Forms
description: Translate a public Google Form into a voice-ready draft while preserving a reviewable field list and explicit limitations.
steps: Review sections and grid questions carefully
Test voice and typed paths before sharing
limitations: Grid questions, quizzes, images, and section routing may need redesign
Restricted Workspace forms cannot be imported anonymously
Responses remain separate from Google Forms unless you build an approved integration

name: Jotform
description: Create an editable conversational draft from a public Jotform and verify field semantics before collecting answers.
limitations: Widgets, calculations, payments, signatures, and uploads do not map automatically
Talkform does not write results back to Jotform by default

name: HubSpot forms
description: Turn a public HubSpot form into a conversational intake draft, then map exports into your approved CRM workflow.
steps: Copy the public form or landing-page URL
Import and review the extracted draft
Test export and approved CRM handling
limitations: Progressive profiling, enrichment, consent widgets, and automation do not carry over automatically
Talkform does not claim a native HubSpot write-back
CRM deduplication and lawful-basis rules remain your responsibility
